description.fun: Horsea anchors itself with its curly tail when currents get strong, and plays with other Horsea using it when the water is calm. If danger comes near, it squirts water or black ink from its tube-shaped mouth. Horsea dance as they swim, stirring up whirlpools, and compete to make the biggest one. It's the fathers, not the mothers, that raise the young.
description.guide: A small, seahorse-like Water Pokémon that shoots water or ink from its tube-shaped mouth and anchors itself with its curled tail. It nests in coral reefs. It evolves into Seadra, which evolves into Kingdra when traded holding a Dragon Scale.
description.tagline: A little seahorse that shoots ink and stirs up whirlpools

description.fun: Seadra's fin tips carry a venom strong enough to make people numb or faint, yet it's prized in traditional medicine. It hunts by spinning to whip up whirlpools, then swallows its worn-out prey whole. Male Seadra look after the young and turn vicious around the nest, attacking anything that comes near with venom that grows thicker than usual.
description.guide: The middle stage of Horsea's line, a seahorse-like Water Pokémon with venomous, spiked fins. It catches prey by creating whirlpools, and males guard the nest fiercely. It evolves into Kingdra when traded holding a Dragon Scale.
description.tagline: A venomous seahorse and a fiercely protective dad

description.fun: Kingdra sleeps deep on the seabed to build up its strength, and even its yawn churns up currents that can sink small ships. It's said to wake and wander when storms roll in, raising whirlpools and waterspouts. Its Dragon type may come from an old belief, reflected in the Japanese word for seahorse, that a seahorse that lives for a century turns into a dragon.
description.guide: The final stage of Horsea's line, introduced in Generation 2, a seahorse-like Water and Dragon Pokémon. It lives deep on the sea floor and can create whirlpools and waterspouts. It evolves from Seadra when traded holding a Dragon Scale.
description.tagline: A storm-raising sea dragon that naps on the ocean floor
